title: Clarify: One Decision That Makes a Thousand
coreMove: Write an essential intent concrete enough to settle hundreds of later decisions before they become debates.
sourcePressure: The chapter begins elimination by showing that vague purpose produces politics, scattered effort, and short-term wins that do not add up.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would write about vision statements or inspirational goals without behavioral specificity.

hook: generic clarify: one decision that makes a thousand topic opener
tryThisNow: set a timer for ninety seconds...
make a list of priorities without a trade-off
generic say no to one thing today

exampleSpecs.domain: city archive digitization project drowning in donor requests
exampleSpecs.audience: archive director whose team is scanning whatever the loudest family requests next
exampleSpecs.stakes: the grant year can create usable eviction records or a decorative sampler
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She writes digitize every eviction docket from 1930 to 1960 before commemorative requests on the white access board.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A white access board stands beside a box of eviction dockets.

exampleSpecs.domain: public aquarium rebuilding its school visit program
exampleSpecs.audience: education manager whose staff keeps adding fun stations
exampleSpecs.stakes: students may leave entertained but unable to act locally
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Before, every tank gets a worksheet; after, he pins every fifth grader leaves able to test runoff at home above the touch-pool cart.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A touch-pool cart is covered with activity sheets.

exampleSpecs.domain: open-source accessibility project choosing which issues to accept
exampleSpecs.audience: maintainer whose queue mixes nice improvements with core purpose
exampleSpecs.stakes: the project can become pleasant or excellent at one hard workflow
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She pastes blind shoppers complete checkout without help above the issue board and closes a popular color-theme request.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An issue board glows beneath a pasted intent card.

exampleSpecs.domain: regional food bank redesigning delivery routes after fuel costs rise
exampleSpecs.audience: logistics director balancing speed, fairness, donor preference, and habit
exampleSpecs.stakes: families with no transport need reliable staples more than visible stops
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: He pins serve every no-car household with a weekly staple box above the route map and ends the donor-stop debate.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A route map is pinned with fuel receipts.

exampleSpecs.domain: materials lab choosing experiments for a biodegradable packaging prototype
exampleSpecs.audience: lab lead whose researchers chase disconnected tests
exampleSpecs.stakes: the prototype needs one market proof rather than impressive fragments
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She writes survive frozen shipping and compost in ninety days on the lab sash, and half the clever experiments lose permission.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A lab sash is crowded with test labels.

exampleSpecs.domain: county public defender intake redesign after missed court notices
exampleSpecs.audience: intake supervisor whose team keeps adding forms
exampleSpecs.stakes: clients need clear appearance information more than internal paperwork
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: She tapes every client leaves knowing date, room, and ride plan above the intake window, then removes two forms.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Two extra forms sit beneath a taped court-date card.

skillTargets: identify essential intent inside a concrete scenario
choose the response that makes one clear decision govern later debates
reject the generic drift: A weak run would write about vision statements or inspirational goals without behavioral specificity.
explain the trade-off using source-specific terms rather than generic productivity language

tryThisNowSpec: Choose one drifting project. Write one essential intent in the form: by when, for whom, what concrete result, and what will no longer win.
